title: Spiders In Your Sleep Myth

scenes.text: Every night you swallow eight spiders while you sleep
People think we accidentally eat dozens of spiders during sleep
scenes.label: We eat spiders nightly

scenes.text: Surveys show no evidence; the story began as a joke, not science
scenes.label: No proof of spider meals

scenes.text: Follow for a mind-blowing fact every day.

description: The creepy idea that you swallow spiders every night is pure fiction. Learn why the legend has no scientific backing. Follow for more myth‑busting facts!
